definitions.explanation: LINE; a popular messaging and social media application widely used in Japan

examples.japanese: LINE⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}して→連絡する：20202_renrakusuru⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
LINE⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{既読|きどく}→既読：06483_kidoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ついた⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{返事|へんじ}→返事：00844_henji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: They read my LINE message but haven't replied.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧LINE⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦グループ→グループ：03840_guruupu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{追加|ついか}した→追加する：19646_tsuikasuru⟧。
examples.english: I added a friend to the LINE group.

notes:
LINE is a messaging app developed by LINE Corporation (originally a subsidiary of the Korean company Naver). Launched in 2011 after the Tohoku earthquake, it became the dominant messaging platform in Japan.

KEY FEATURES:
- ⟦{既読|きどく}→既読：06483_kidoku⟧ (read receipt) - Shows when messages are read
- ⟦スタンプ→スタンプ：11577_sutanpu⟧ (stickers) - Decorative images for messaging
- ⟦グループ→グループ：03840_guruupu⟧ (groups) - Group chat function
- ⟦{通話|つうわ}→通話：14369_tsuuwa⟧ (calls) - Voice and video calling

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- LINE⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to send a LINE message, to LINE someone)
- LINE⟦{交換|こうかん}→交換：02746_koukan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to exchange LINE contact info)
- LINE⟦{追加|ついか}する→追加する：19646_tsuikasuru⟧ (to add on LINE)
- ⟦{既読|きどく}スルー→既読スルー：10294_kidokusuruu⟧ (ignoring a message after reading it)

CULTURAL NOTE:
LINE is essentially ubiquitous in Japan. Asking for someone's LINE is the standard way to exchange contact information, particularly among younger generations. Many businesses and organizations also use LINE for official communications.

REGISTER: Neutral. Used across all age groups and contexts.
